notes: «وعن أمير المؤمنين علي عليه السلام أنه قال» names only the Imam: the chain before him is not written in this report.

None of the twelve previous reports (prev1 to prev12) writes a name or a chain (has_written_chain false, each opens «وعن» with no names), so nothing is inherited; the text's own name is the whole reading.
The Imam is named inside the chain after «عن», so he stays a narrator (owner ruling 2).
